items.title: Beyond Static Snapshots: A Grounded Evaluation Framework for Language Models at the Agentic Frontier
items.title_zh: 超越静态快照：面向智能体前沿的语言模型扎根评估框架
items.summary: The paper argues current LLM evaluation suffers from distributional, temporal, scope and process invalidity, and proposes the Grounded Continuous Evaluation framework with ISOPro as a reference implementation. ISOPro replaces a learned reward model with a deterministic verifier and updates LoRA adapters on CPU; across twelve cells it yields a mean gain of +9.0 points versus -1.5 for GRPO-LoRA at consumer-budget settings, with held-out MBPP generalization reaching 40% on two of three architectures.

items.title: Agents Explore but Agents Ignore: LLMs Lack Environmental Curiosity
items.title_zh: 智能体会探索却不会利用：LLM 缺乏环境好奇心
items.summary: Across Terminal-Bench, SWE-Bench and AppWorld, the authors inject complete task solutions into agent environments and find agents discover them in 79-81% of Terminal-Bench runs but exploit them in only 37-50% of cases. In AppWorld, agents see documentation stating a command returns the full solution in over 90% of attempts yet exploit it in fewer than 7%, a gap the authors attribute to missing environmental curiosity and link to available tools, test-time compute and training data distribution.

items.title: CoSearch: Joint Training of Reasoning and Document Ranking via Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search
items.title_zh: CoSearch：面向智能体搜索的推理与文档排序联合强化学习训练
items.summary: CoSearch jointly trains a multi-step reasoning agent and a generative document ranker with GRPO, after a preliminary experiment found up to a 26.8% relative F1 gap between oracle and fixed retrieval across seven QA benchmarks. A semantic grouping strategy clusters sub-queries by token similarity to form valid ranker optimization groups, and a composite reward combines ranking quality with trajectory-level outcomes; gains are consistent on seven single- and multi-hop QA benchmarks.

items.title: PV-SQL: Synergizing Database Probing and Rule-based Verification for Text-to-SQL Agents
items.title_zh: PV-SQL：结合数据库探测与规则验证的 Text-to-SQL Agent
items.summary: PV-SQL is an agentic text-to-SQL framework whose Probe component queries the database to resolve ambiguities in value formats, column semantics and table relationships, while its Verify component builds an executable checklist from rule-based conditions. It reports a 5% execution-accuracy gain over the best baseline on BIRD.

items.title: Beyond Fine-Tuning: In-Context Learning and Chain-of-Thought for Reasoned Distractor Generation
items.title_zh: 超越微调：面向有理据干扰项生成的上下文学习与思维链
items.summary: The authors explore LLM reasoning for distractor generation through in-context learning with unsupervised semantic retrieval for selecting few-shot examples, and design a rationale-augmented framework that jointly generates distractors and their rationales. Across six benchmarks with varying distractor lengths and domains, few-shot prompting substantially improves over recent DG models and reaches state-of-the-art results.

items.title: Code-Switching Information Retrieval: Benchmarks, Analysis, and the Limits of Current Retrievers
items.title_zh: 语码转换信息检索：基准、分析与当前检索器的局限
items.summary: The authors build CSR-L, a human-annotated benchmark of naturally mixed-language queries, and find code-switching degrades statistical, dense and late-interaction retrievers, tracing the failure to substantial embedding-space divergence between pure and code-switched text. They also propose CS-MTEB, covering 11 tasks, where performance declines reach 27%, and show vocabulary expansion alone does not close the gap.

items.title: Compiling Deterministic Structure into SLM Harnesses
items.title_zh: 将确定性结构编译进小模型执行框架
items.summary: Semantic Gradient Descent (SGDe) is a teacher-student framework in which a frontier teacher writes natural-language critiques that act as directional gradients to refine an SLM's workflow artifacts, compiling them into DAG topologies, system prompts and deterministic code. On an adversarial GSM-Hard set, compiled workflows reach 91.3% accuracy at m=5 and 99.3% at m=3, a 26.3-34.3 point absolute gain over state-of-the-art prompt optimizers.

items.title: Peerispect: Claim Verification in Scientific Peer Reviews
items.title_zh: Peerispect：同行评审中的论断验证
items.summary: Peerispect extracts check-worthy claims from peer reviews, retrieves evidence from the manuscript and verifies claims through natural language inference, highlighting supporting evidence in an interface. It is released as a modular information-retrieval pipeline with a public demo and API.

items.title: Jupiter-N Technical Report
items.summary: Jupiter-N is a hybrid reasoning model post-trained from the fully open-source 120B Nemotron 3 Super, targeting agentic capability via uncertainty-curated trajectories, UK cultural alignment and Welsh language support. Using the Forget-Me-Not framework to mix on-policy synthetic replay with off-policy task data, it gains +18 on ARC-Easy and +5.25 on MMLU-Lite for Welsh, +9.1 on Terminal Bench 2 and +4.4 on IFBench while retaining base capabilities, with weights and post-training data released openly.
